judge.rationale: The candidate satisfies every acceptance criterion from the issue: it removes the `instanceof Error` gate in `chatOrchestrator.ts`, wraps non-`Error` rejections in `new Error(String(error), {cause: error})` while passing `Error` instances through unchanged, and preserves the original rejection at the caller boundary. It covers string, plain object, and `undefined` rejections in unit tests while leaving existing `Error` tests unedited, updates `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` (along with line-number references in other specs), and adds a clear entry to `CHANGELOG.md`. It differs slightly from the reference by using `String(error)` directly instead of attempting `JSON.stringify` first via `describeRejection`, and by adding an extra `onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts` file alongside the unit test in `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`. Noticeably, in `onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts`, the eslint-disable comment `// eslint-disable-next-line require-yield` lacks a description, which might fail if eslint requires descriptions, though `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` originally had a bare disable comment too.
